name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
changes.summary: Lindell, of MyPillow, plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents. (Image credit: Dana Ferguson).

changes.title: Trump announces staff secretary Will Scharf, who helped secure ballroom approval, will be his new White House counsel
changes.summary: Democrats have vowed to pursue investigations into Trump and his administration if they are successful in November.

changes.title: Minnesota’s Democratic Senate Primary Pits Angie Craig Against Peggy Flanagan
changes.summary: The Senate primary race in Minnesota will be the latest test of left-wing energy in the party, in a state that was convulsed by the Trump administration’s deadly immigration crackdown this winter.

changes.title: Netanyahu Walks Tightrope on Trump’s Gaza Disarmament Deal
changes.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel is trying to satisfy the sometimes competing demands of his right-wing base and President Trump months ahead of a tough election.

changes.title: Iran Says U.S. Must Meet These Six Demands If Strait of Hormuz Is to Reopen
changes.summary: President Donald Trump speaks to the press after signing an Executive Order in the Oval Office of the White House on March 31, 2026. —Brendan Smialowski—Getty Images Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on Sunday said an agreement with Oman to define new shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz was in its “final.

changes.title: Taiwan practices war games as it fears increasing Chinese aggression, questions Trump's support
changes.summary: Taiwan continued its 10-day war games this weekend, preparing for a potential invasion by China, which claims the territory as its own and has threatened to seize it by force. Anna Coren has more details from Taiwan.

changes.title: Trump Vows to Take Ballroom Battle to the Supreme Court
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s planned ballroom is in jeopardy after a federal appeals court ruled Congress should have approved the project first. The president is now calling on the Supreme Court to overturn that decision. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Trump officials offer cities tens of millions for Memphis-style police surges – with conditions
changes.summary: DoJ to give $300m for enforcement surges in four cities, as long as they abandon progressive ideologies on policing The Trump administration is offering grants of tens of millions of dollars to cities across the US to create more Memphis -style enforcement surges – on the condition that they abandon progressive ideolog.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical-minerals dominance.

changes.title: Trump is still searching for a way out of Iran
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is struggling to find a way out of the conflict with Iran, as voters lose patience with the war and weapons stockpiles dwindle. The path forward remains unclear, even as Trump has privately weighed dropping his long-held requirement for a nuclear deal. Washington is unlikely to accept Iran’s late.
